title: Projektetage Intro Flow Drag Scale
description: Fix projektetage intro slides 0-6 where dragging text shoots elements out quickly; slide 9 (canvas) works. Root cause likely sectionVisualScale using tall nested reveal stack offsetHeight vs viewport-sized client rect.
summary:
Fixed hypersensitive text drag on projektetage intro slides 0–6.

Root cause: `sectionVisualScale` compared visible slide bounds from `slideLayoutBounds` against `slideCoordinateRoot` layout size. On nested reveal.js vertical stacks, the coordinate root is the full stack (offsetHeight ≈ N× slide height) while client bounds stay one viewport tall, so scale was far too small and `flowPointerDeltaToLocal` amplified pointer movement.

Fix: when layout exceeds slide bounds, use CSS slide dimensions as layout reference. Added regression test for nested stack with 4900px layout vs 700px slide.

Files: `framework/product/presentation/renderer/react/index.tsx`
